goals: Provide exactly one shapeless Dirt plus Hanging Roots recipe producing one Rooted Dirt without an advancement or advancement tab.
Make placed Hanging Roots duplicate one Hanging Roots item through vanilla bonemeal handling while leaving the source block intact and preserving vanilla Rooted Dirt behavior.
Supersede the accepted Craftable Rooted Dirt predecessor only through a future mutually exclusive runtime transition.
scope: Maintain the Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric recipe and sole structural HangingRootsBlock mixin from Canary 1.
Retain ordinary hand and dispenser bonemeal support through the unchanged vanilla BoneMealItem growCrop path.

exclusions: Items, blocks, entrypoints, access wideners, commands, keybinds, configuration, GUI, advancements, advancement tabs, assets, and mechanics beyond the one recipe and Hanging Roots bonemeal contract.
Bonemeal-item or dispenser interception, RootedDirtBlock changes, Matcha-specific behavior, unrelated blocks, registries, and mutation of the placed Hanging Roots block.
Concurrent activation with craft-rooted-dirt-107.1.jar (mr_craft_rooteddirt); the accepted predecessor must be disabled before Canary 1 is deployed.
Runtime deployment, Test Slot changes, Test Instance Manager changes, Workbench profile changes, and protected gameplay profile access during this migration.
